# UserUpdateRequest

Changes another user of the tenant: their role and whether they may sign in. Tenant admins only.

**Kind:** an object, used in requests.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `isAdmin` | `boolean` |  | True to make the user a tenant admin (`Tenant.Admin`); false for an ordinary member (`Tenant.User`). |
| `isEnabled` | `boolean` |  | Whether the user may sign in. |

## Example

```json
{
  "isAdmin": false,
  "isEnabled": false
}
```

## Where it's used

- [`users.update`](../api/users.md) (`PUT /users/by-id/{id}`)
